text: Economics is often emphasis on the teaching of theoretical knowledge than international trade or other courses. Why choose study this program? With long tradition of producing global-ready graduates, the IUPs will try to prepare students to be talents with global competencies, intellectual and practical skills, personal development and social responsibility, integrative learning, openness, development and inequality. As one major field of IUPs, which is one of the best international undergraduate programs ( the field of international trade is No.1 in China) , the course of economics is outstanding in China. Main Courses and credits Each student must complete 54 credits of courses including 36 compulsory, 18 elective and 8 for a practicum requirement. More majors will be offered as enrollment expands such as Accounting and East Asian Studies (jointly offered with Nagoya University and Soongsil University) Students received the admission notice should pay 10,000 RMB advanced payment of tuition fee to secure study qualification.The advanced payment is non-refundable and will be applied to the tuition for the first year.
